GROK 4.5 RANKS AMONG THE TOP FOR AGENTIC CODING AT LOW COST

Grok 4.5 with Grok Build continues to deliver strong results on agentic coding and knowledge work benchmarks while remaining one of the most cost-efficient frontier models available.

Key highlights:

•  High performance on agentic coding and workflow benchmarks
•  Significantly lower cost per task than Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5/5.6
•  Excellent token efficiency while maintaining competitive output quality

It may not always claim the absolute top spot on every general intelligence leaderboard, but Grok 4.5 consistently ranks among the best when it comes to practical agentic coding performance at a much lower price.

GROK 4.5 RANKS #1 FOR REAL-WORLD CODING QUALITY
In a direct head-to-head test by Command Code, Grok 4.5, Fable 5, and GPT 5.5 were given the exact same prompt to build a game.
Results:
•  Grok 4.5: 9/10 — Produced a genuinely polished, finished mobile game experience.
•  Fable 5: 7.5/10
•  GPT 5.5: 7/10
The other two models felt rushed and lacked refinement, while Grok 4.5 delivered clean, high-quality output.
This isn’t just another benchmark number — it’s a real-world test showing Grok 4.5’s strength in producing production-ready, polished results rather than just fast but incomplete code.
Another strong signal that Grok 4.5 is excelling where it matters most: actual developer experience and final quality.

LEGACY MEDIA HAS A LONG HISTORY OF LYING ABOUT ELON MUSK

Here are just a few examples of misleading or outright false headlines over the years:

•  “Elon Musk calls diver ‘pedo guy’ in unprovoked attack” (ignoring the full context of the Thai cave rescue exchange)
•  “Elon Musk is moving Tesla headquarters out of California over taxes and politics” (the plans had been in motion for years for operational reasons)
•  “Elon Musk is firing all content moderators and making Twitter unsafe” (most moderation changes were different from what was reported)
•  “Tesla is in danger of bankruptcy” (repeatedly claimed during difficult periods while the company was executing long-term plans)
•  Various headlines framing routine hand gestures or jokes as “Nazi salutes” or extreme political statements
This pattern of distortion isn’t new. Legacy media has repeatedly twisted Elon’s words, actions, and business decisions to fit a negative narrative.
The latest example with Grok 4.5 testing at Tesla and SpaceX is just the most recent case of the same behavior.




Elon Musk (@elonmusk)

KARDASHEV TYPE II IS UNLOCKED WITH STARSHIP

A Kardashev Type II civilization is one that can harness the total energy output of its star.

Humanity is still extremely early on that scale. To reach Type II, we need to move heavy industry, manufacturing, and massive energy infrastructure into space — where we can build on a planetary scale without Earth’s limitations.

Starship makes this possible.
It’s the only vehicle capable of delivering the millions of tons of material needed to construct orbital solar power arrays, space-based data centers, and large-scale infrastructure in orbit and beyond.
This is how we go from being a single-planet species to one that can actually tap into stellar-level energy:
•  Unlimited clean power from constant sunlight
•  Massive compute and manufacturing capacity in orbit
•  The ability to support a self-sustaining civilization on multiple planets
Starship isn’t just about going to Mars. It’s the key that unlocks the next level of civilization.

OPENAI IS HAVING A ROUGH 24 HOURS
OpenAI is dealing with multiple major issues at once:

•  Fidji Simo, OpenAI’s No. 2 executive (product and applications chief), is stepping down from her full-time role due to a severe flare-up of a chronic illness. She’s moving to a part-time advisory position, with her responsibilities being split among Greg Brockman, Sarah Friar, and Jason Kwon.
•  Johannes Heidecke, OpenAI’s head of safety systems, is also leaving as the company reorganizes and merges its research and safety teams.

On top of the leadership exits, reports indicate there have now been over 20 lawsuits filed against OpenAI related to suicide and homicide cases involving ChatGPT.

This comes as OpenAI continues to face questions around safety practices, internal restructuring, and leadership stability — all while competing in an increasingly intense AI race.

The company is going through significant turbulence at the top at a critical time.
